composition_subtypes.role: Sort all candidate fret-note pairs by fret value
Sliding window to find minimal range covering all notes

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort all candidate fret-note pairs, then two-pointer sliding window to find minimal range covering all notes.
payload.rationale: Combines sorting of candidate frets with amortized two-pointer window to efficiently select one fret per note minimizing max-min difference.
